commentary.text: 90+8' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+7' It looks like Raul Garcia (Ath Bilbao) saw red with that tackle. Mario Melero Lopez won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. A free kick is awarded to Girona.
90+4' Raul Garcia (Ath Bilbao) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Girona.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
90' Ernesto Valverde Tejedor prepares a substitution. Inaki Williams is replaced by Adu Ares (Ath Bilbao).
90' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Oihan Sancet trots off the pitch and is replaced by Unai Gomez (Ath Bilbao).
90' 12:13 – the total goal attempt statistics.
89' Girona are ruled offside.

89' What an opportunity that was! The ball rebounded out to Pablo Torre (Girona), whose shot from the edge of the box goes a whisker wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Ath Bilbao.
87' The corner is swung in but Girona can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

87' What a great touch by Pablo Torre (Girona) as he controls a fine pass into the box and takes a shot to the bottom left corner, but an opposing player makes a clearance. Great defending. Girona get a corner.
85' Substitution. Yangel Herrera leaves the pitch and is replaced by Ibrahima Kebe (Girona).
85' Michel has decided to substitute Viktor Tsygankov and he is replaced by Valery (Girona).
81' Ath Bilbao take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
81' The substitution is prepared. Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Nico Williams.
81' Ernesto Valverde Tejedor has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Ander Herrera (Ath Bilbao) replacing Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta.
77' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Pablo Torre (Girona) comes onto the pitch so that Ivan Martin can be given a rest.
77' Eric Garcia (Girona) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Mario Melero Lopez signals. Ath Bilbao have been awarded a free kick.

76' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Girona are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
74' Substitution. Gorka Guruzeta is replaced by Raul Garcia (Ath Bilbao).

71' A short pass finds Yangel Herrera (Girona). He spots the keeper off his line and shoots from mid-range, but the ball sails high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Ath Bilbao.
69' Here is a change. Arnau Martinez is going off and Michel gives the last tactical orders to Yan Couto (Girona).
69' It will be a substitution. Portu (Girona) is ready to enter the pitch as Cristhian Stuani walks off.
67' 1 - 1 Goal! A great through ball by Oihan Sancet sets up Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) inside the box, and he makes no mistake and bangs the ball into the bottom right corner. 1:1.
67' Miguel Gutierrez (Girona) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.
66' The linesman makes the right call and Ath Bilbao will have a corner.
65' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat. Good work from Ath Bilbao as they win a corner.

59' Daley Blind (Girona) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul. Ath Bilbao win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal. Daley Blind (Girona) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
57' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Ath Bilbao comes to nothing.
55' 1 - 0 Goal! Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the right post. It's 1:0.
51' Mario Melero Lopez shows a yellow card to Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) for his blatant foul.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+1' Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) is adjudged offside.
45' The match has reached half-time.
45' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
44' Ath Bilbao failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

44' A promising cross into the box is nearly received by the lurking Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao), but one of the defending players cuts it out to avert the threat. Ath Bilbao force a corner. They send men into the box.
44' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Ath Bilbao.

43' Dani Vivian (Ath Bilbao) connects with the free kick and produces a header goalwards which is well blocked. The goalkeeper doesn't have to worry about that one. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Ath Bilbao.

42' Yangel Herrera (Girona) does well to dispossess the attacker with a slide tackle, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Free kick. Ath Bilbao will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
40' Aleix Garcia (Girona) is penalised for a foul. Mario Melero Lopez had a clear view and blows his whistle. Ath Bilbao get a free kick.

39' Miguel Gutierrez (Girona) receives a precise pass and threatens the keeper with a long-range shot. His attempt goes miles wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Ath Bilbao will have a goal kick.
38' The ball is cleared after Savio (Girona) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
35' Aleix Garcia (Girona) has to stretch for the ball in the box and sends it high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Ath Bilbao.
33' Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) brings his opponent down. Mario Melero Lopez has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Girona.
31' Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
31' Dani Vivian (Ath Bilbao) watches the corner all the way, but places his header a whisker wide of the left post from close range. The ball goes out of play and Girona will have a goal kick.

31' A sweet pass finds Dani Vivian (Ath Bilbao) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the roof of the net. Paulo Gazzaniga is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Ath Bilbao.

29' Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) latches onto a lofted pass from Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta on the edge of the six-yard box, but misdirects his header and sends it just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Girona will have a goal kick.
27' Savio (Girona) has a goal ruled out for offside!
25' The game is interrupted as Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) is flagged offside.
23' Oscar de Marcos (Ath Bilbao) is the one to unleash a good effort towards the bottom right corner. His shot, however, is saved by the goalkeeper. What a save!

21' Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the roof of the net is blocked by Paulo Gazzaniga, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
19' Yangel Herrera (Girona) makes a rough challenge and Mario Melero Lopez blows his whistle for a foul. Ath Bilbao will take a free kick.
18' Girona can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

18' Cristhian Stuani (Girona) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header from the six-yard box wasn't accurate enough and the ball glanced away off the left post! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Ath Bilbao.

15' Cristhian Stuani (Girona) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header wasn't accurate at all and the ball went well over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Ath Bilbao will have a goal kick.
14' The foul by Inigo Lekue (Ath Bilbao) was seen by Mario Melero Lopez who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle. It's a free kick to Girona in a dangerous position.
11' Wonderful movement by Girona. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
6' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) takes the resultant free kick from distance and swings it into the box, but the goalkeeper climbs high to collect the ball.

5' Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and drills it towards the right post. Unfortunately for him, Paulo Gazzaniga makes a great save to stop his effort.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and Ath Bilbao will have the kick-off.
Mario Melero Lopez is introduced as the referee for today's match.
